title: Encrypted Cloning, Absolute Maximal Entanglement and Quantum Secret Sharing
summary: The no-cloning theorem prohibits the creation of identical copies of quantum information, imposing fundamental constraints on quantum technologies. A recently proposed protocol, encrypted cloning, introduced by Yamaguchi and Kempf, showed that perfect qubit clones can be produced if they are simultaneously encrypted with a single-use key. They also observed a connection between this scheme and quantum secret sharing (QSS).
